items.title: How Much Higher Can Planet Labs Stock Go From Here?
items.summary: A $10,000 holding in Planet Labs PBC (PL) bought at its late-August high is now worth about $8,200. That fall tempts you to buy, so the real question is how much higher the stock can go from here.
